skill.name: global-coding-style
skill.description: Apply consistent coding standards for PHP, TypeScript, and JavaScript work. The skill covers formatting, naming, type safety, linting, static analysis, and review preparation.
skill.summary: Guide code changes toward consistent formatting, naming, typing, and review readiness.
skill.author: DevanB

security_audit.summary: The skill contains one Markdown link that traverses outside the skill directory at SKILL.md line 30. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found, but the external relative reference is a real marketplace boundary risk.

remediation.issue: The skill references ../../../agent-os/standards/global/coding-style.md from SKILL.md line 30.
remediation.suggestion: Move the referenced guidance into the skill package or link only to files inside the skill directory.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 30 points to ../../../agent-os/standards/global/coding-style.md, which leaves the skill directory. This can cause the skill to depend on unreviewed out-of-package content.

high_findings.title: Path traversal sequence
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: SKILL.md line 30 points to ../../../agent-os/standards/global/coding-style.md, which leaves the skill directory. This can cause the skill to depend on unreviewed out-of-package content.

content.value_statement: Mixed codebases often drift in formatting, names, and type discipline. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code consistent review guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guides PHP, TypeScript, and JavaScript edits toward consistent style rules.
Prompts use of Laravel Pint for PHP formatting work.
Prompts use of Ultracite for JavaScript and TypeScript linting.
Encourages explicit PHP return types and parameter type hints.
Supports cleanup of unused imports, dead code, and commented blocks.
Frames review preparation around readability, maintainability, and DRY principles.
limitations: It does not include the referenced detailed coding standard inside the skill package.
It cannot run formatters or static analyzers without project tooling access.
It does not define language rules for systems outside PHP, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
It provides guidance, not automatic enforcement in a repository.

use_cases.title: Review a Laravel change
use_cases.description: Check PHP edits for type declarations, formatting expectations, unused imports, and review readiness.

use_cases.title: Clean up frontend code
use_cases.description: Apply TypeScript and JavaScript style guidance before linting, formatting, or opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Prepare mixed-stack changes
use_cases.description: Keep naming, formatting, and maintainability expectations aligned across backend and frontend files.

prompt_templates.title: Check style basics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these PHP, TypeScript, or JavaScript changes for naming, formatting, and obvious cleanup issues.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for linting
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup before running project tools.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this change so it is ready for Laravel Pint, Ultracite, and relevant static analysis checks.

prompt_templates.title: Improve type safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this code for missing PHP return types, parameter type hints, TypeScript type gaps, and avoidable dynamic behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit maintainability
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this mixed PHP and TypeScript change for DRY violations, dead code, review risk, and maintainability improvements.

output_examples.input: A PHP controller change with missing return types and unused imports.
output_examples.output: The review identifies missing return declarations, removes unused imports, and recommends running Laravel Pint before review.

output_examples.input: A TypeScript component with inconsistent names and weak prop typing.
output_examples.output: The response suggests clearer names, stronger prop types, and a final Ultracite check.

output_examples.input: A full-stack pull request with repeated validation logic.
output_examples.output: The review flags duplicated logic, suggests consolidation, and lists cleanup steps before submitting.

best_practices: Use the skill before opening a pull request or asking for review.
Run project formatters and static analyzers after applying style changes.
Pair style guidance with repository-specific rules when they are available.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a replacement for automated linting or tests.
Do not apply broad refactors when a focused formatting change is enough.
Do not follow external file references unless the content is included and reviewed.

faq.question: Which languages does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets PHP, TypeScript, and JavaScript codebases.

faq.question: Does it run Laravel Pint or Ultracite?
faq.answer: No. It guides when those tools should be used, but tool execution depends on the local project.

faq.question: Can it help with code review preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on formatting, naming, type safety, dead code, and maintainability before review.

faq.question: Does it enforce project-specific rules?
faq.answer: Only when those rules are available in the current project context.

faq.question: Is it suitable for new files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide new PHP, TypeScript, and JavaScript files from the start.

faq.question: What is the main audit concern?
faq.answer: The skill links to a parent-directory file that is outside the packaged skill content.
